title: Sweep sends every listed request, startup included, with the signed-in token, and ignores each row's auth field
notes: Startup requests (/System/Info/Public, /Users/Public, /QuickConnect/Enabled) are sent by clients before sign-in with no Token. The sweep always sends the user's token and never reads the row's `auth` field, so a regression that makes those routes require auth passes. This is the criterion's 'Authorization header form' item: it is listed but never sent. Closed at the pivot: Tied to a Jellyfin route, a Jellyfin app, jellyfin-web, Quick Connect or Jellyfin's tooling, all removed at the cutover (D-107, D-109, rule 3).
